answer: A sybil attacker's plume of duplicate identities then becomes expensive, since every clone demands fresh stake and computation. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, raising the cost of spawning fake accounts. Reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, so a lone island of self-dealing accounts gains no weight. Only agents passing a periodic summit review by established peers can vote or earn rewards, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
